rules.name: recon-dup-01-snapshot-duplicates
rules.sql: WITH lp AS ( SELECT p.business_unit, p.settlement_date, p.published_run_id, p.published_at FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p2.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p2.business_unit = p.business_unit AND p2.view_type = p.view_type) ) SELECT lp.business_unit, lp.settlement_date, lp.published_at, r.status AS run_status, r.row_count AS run_row_count, x.rows_in_run, x.distinct_trade_id, x.distinct_wide_key, x.rows_in_run - x.distinct_wide_key AS extra_rows_wide_key, x.rows_in_run - x.distinct_trade_id AS extra_rows_trade_id, x.rows_in_run - COALESCE(r.row_count, 0) AS rows_beyond_run_count FROM lp LEFT JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = lp.published_run_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS rows_in_run, count(DISTINCT s.trade_id) AS distinct_trade_id, count(DISTINCT md5(concat_ws('|', s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.portfolio, s.value_date, s.parent_trade_id, s.derivative_type, s.instrument_class))) AS distinct_wide_key FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = lp.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = lp.settlement_date AND s.run_id = lp.published_run_id ) x ORDER BY extra_rows_wide_key DESC, lp.business_unit

WITH lp AS ( SELECT p.business_unit, p.settlement_date, p.published_run_id, p.published_at FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p2.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p2.business_unit = p.business_unit AND p2.view_type = p.view_type) ) SELECT lp.business_unit, lp.settlement_date, lp.published_at, r.status AS run_status, r.row_count AS run_row_count, x.rows_in_run, x.distinct_trade_id, x.distinct_wide_key, x.rows_in_run - x.distinct_wide_key AS extra_rows_wide_key, x.rows_in_run - x.distinct_trade_id AS extra_rows_trade_id, x.rows_in_run - COALESCE(r.row_count, 0) AS rows_beyond_run_count FROM lp LEFT JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = lp.published_run_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS rows_in_run, count(DISTINCT s.trade_id) AS distinct_trade_id, count(DISTINCT md5(concat_ws('|', s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.portfolio, s.value_date, s.parent_trade_id, s.derivative_type, s.instrument_class))) AS distinct_wide_key FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = lp.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = lp.settlement_date AND s.run_id = lp.published_run_id ) x ORDER BY extra_rows_wide_key DESC, lp.business_unit

SELECT r.business_unit, r.view_type, r.resolved_settlement_date, r.uuid AS run_id, r.status, r.row_count AS run_row_count, CASE r.view_type WHEN 'SETTLE_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = r.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = r.resolved_settlement_date AND s.run_id = r.uuid) WHEN 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = r.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = r.resolved_settlement_date AND s.run_id = r.uuid) END AS rows_counted, (p.published_run_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_published, r.requested_by, r.requested_at, r.started_at, r.completed_at FROM opera.recon_refresh_run r LEFT JOIN opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p ON p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = r.business_unit AND p.view_type = r.view_type AND p.settlement_date = r.resolved_settlement_date AND p.published_run_id = r.uuid WHERE r.tenant_id = :tenant AND r.requested_at >= :since AND r.view_type IN ('SETTLE_PRICING', 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING') AND r.status <> 'MANUAL_TEST' ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC LIMIT 300

WITH lp AS ( SELECT p.business_unit, p.settlement_date, p.published_run_id FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p2.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p2.business_unit = p.business_unit AND p2.view_type = p.view_type) ) SELECT s.business_unit, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT s.uuid) AS n_uuid, count(DISTINCT s.created_timestamp) AS n_created_timestamps, min(s.created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(s.created_timestamp) AS last_created, string_agg(DISTINCT s.created_by, ',') AS created_by_users, string_agg(DISTINCT s.updated_by, ',') AS updated_by_users, string_agg(DISTINCT s.source_trade_id, ',') AS source_trade_ids FROM lp JOIN opera.recon_settle_snapshot s ON s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = lp.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = lp.settlement_date AND s.run_id = lp.published_run_id GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, s.business_unit, s.trade_id LIMIT 30

WITH lp AS ( SELECT p.business_unit, p.settlement_date, p.published_run_id FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p2.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p2.business_unit = p.business_unit AND p2.view_type = p.view_type) ) SELECT s.business_unit, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT s.uuid) AS n_uuid, count(DISTINCT s.created_timestamp) AS n_created_timestamps, min(s.created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(s.created_timestamp) AS last_created, string_agg(DISTINCT s.created_by, ',') AS created_by_users, string_agg(DISTINCT s.updated_by, ',') AS updated_by_users FROM lp JOIN opera.recon_actual_snapshot s ON s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = lp.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = lp.settlement_date AND s.run_id = lp.published_run_id GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, s.business_unit, s.trade_id LIMIT 30

expect.reason: no BU has duplicate rows in its published SETTLE_PRICING run
no BU has duplicate rows in its published SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING run
the published settle run holds no more rows than the row_count it recorded
the published actual run holds no more rows than the row_count it recorded
every completed run holds exactly the row_count it recorded
no refresh run that is not the published one still holds snapshot rows
